key_line.detail: Third straight quarter far above guide: $235.2m (+151% y/y; direct $118.8m +112%, third-party $116.4m +209%) vs $160-164m guide; policies 142,111 (+189%); ARPU $1,655 (-13% y/y) on third-party mix; adj. EBITDA margin 15%.

guidance.detail: FY2026 revenue $838-842m (was $727-731m), adj. EBITDA $134-136m (was $119-123m per a snippet). Q4 revenue $220-224m (+102% y/y at midpoint), adj. EBITDA $30-32m, against the ~$184m Q4 the old FY range implied and a street that tracked it. New $100m Class A buyback authorized.

call.detail: Call held last night at 16:30 ET. No transcript or call-highlights article was found by 09:18 ET, so tone and Q&A are unread; the only known risk items going in were third-party mix margin and the $8m carrier-settlement cash reversal.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions or post-release articles were indexed by 09:18 ET. The pre-print average target (~$37.50, per the hunt) sits well below the pre-market price, so target raises during the day are likely but none were seen. Media tone is read off the release only.

tape_read.note: Robust reference $48.74 (+14.4% vs $42.62 prev close); last print $49.41 at 09:09 is the pre-market high and the price rose from +11.3% after hours, so the move is still building. 26 prints, 11 in the last 30 min, not stale. Below the release read of +18%, the option-implied 23.8% and both beat-and-raise analogues (+21%, +32%).

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a large beat against a deliberately low guide plus a mechanical FY raise; both happened and were larger than the run-rate case (+42% vs +13% expected on revenue). The offset named yesterday, the 46% run into the print, is what holds the pre-market below the analogues.

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market is active and rising into its last print, so the open should hold the move; a gap of this size usually gives some back in the first half hour, offset here by a beat that is unambiguous, a price still below the release read and the analogues, and target raises likely during the morning.

recommendation.limit_basis: About +19.7% vs the $42.62 close: just above the +18% release read and below the 23.8% implied move, about 4.6% above the $48.74 pre-market reference; reachable if the session closes the gap to the August (+21%) analogue.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn veel beter dan verwacht: omzet ruim 40% boven de verwachting en de jaarprognose flink omhoog, en de koers staat voorbeurs pas ongeveer 14% hoger, minder dan de vorige twee keren. Zet daarom een verkooplimiet op $51,00 in plaats van bij de opening te verkopen; wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Zakt de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terug onder ongeveer $47 (onder +10%), dan toch bij de opening verkopen.
